name: Contacts
author: Ruegen
description: Local address book for Omarchy. Search and edit contacts from the bar, import a vCard dump from a Mac, and optionally keep them in step with iCloud.

barWidget.description: Address book in the bar. Click to open the list. Super+C does the same from the keyboard.

schema.label: Show the contact count in the bar
schema.description: Turn this on to show how many contacts you have next to the icon.

schema.label: iCloud sync every (seconds)
schema.description: How often to talk to iCloud while Contacts is running. Two minutes is the floor so Apple's servers are not hammered.

schema.label: Auto-import dropped vCard files
schema.description: When on, a .vcf dropped into the import folder is added to the address book without opening the window.
